SELECT timestamp,log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] AS application_name,
CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'storage.objects')>0 THEN 'storage.objects' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'objects')>0 THEN 'objects' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'realtime.subscription')>0 THEN 'realtime.subscription' ELSE 'other' END AS target,
length(log_attributes['parsed.query']) AS query_length,
extract(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'(?i)(select|insert|update|delete|with)') AS query_kind,
arrayFilter(x->positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],x)>0,['for update','for share','pg_advisory','on conflict','storage.objects','storage.buckets','insert into','update','delete from','bucket_id','owner_id','is_admin','foldername','create_folders','lock_top_prefixes','storage.add_prefixes']) AS query_features,
extract(log_attributes['parsed.context'],'(?:PL/pgSQL|SQL) function ([a-zA-Z0-9_.]+)') AS function_context,
CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'statement timeout')>0 THEN 'statement_timeout' ELSE 'other_cancel' END AS kind
FROM logs WHERE source='postgres_logs' AND log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code']='57014' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 8
